families.student_action: Fill inline blanks by choosing tiles from a bank.
families.bank_rules: Tile bank includes required tiles and misconception distractors; reuse default false.
families.placement_or_order_rules: Each blank accepts one tile unless configured otherwise.
families.focus_keyboard: keyboard tile selection and blank assignment; feedback associates missing or wrong tiles with blanks
families.target_proof_limit: eligible for bounded completion only; not a full explanation substitute

families.student_action: Build a reasoning sentence or causal chain from word or fragment tokens.
families.bank_rules: Token bank must force causal or answer-form structure and include misconception distractors.
families.placement_or_order_rules: Order matters; equivalent accepted sequences must be reviewed explicitly.
families.focus_keyboard: keyboard token add/remove/reorder; feedback identifies missing link, wrong direction, or unsupported conclusion
families.target_proof_limit: eligible only when fragment sequence matches reviewed answer-form structure; not broad semantic evaluation

families.student_action: Build a formula from symbols, variables, operators, or terms.
families.bank_rules: Formula bank distinguishes numerator, denominator, operators, parentheses, multipliers, and notation tokens.
families.placement_or_order_rules: Order and grouping matter; equivalence beyond reviewed sequences belongs to later formula-equivalence work.
families.focus_keyboard: keyboard token add/remove/reorder; feedback identifies misplaced basis, numerator, denominator, or operator
families.target_proof_limit: proves formula construction only; calculation execution still needs calculation-work task

families.student_action: Select multiple relevant source, table, or graph values and assign roles.
families.expected_shape: { kind: 'source_value_selection', selections: [{ valueId: string, role: string }] }
families.bank_rules: Value bank includes labels, units, periods, roles, and plausible distractors.
families.placement_or_order_rules: Role assignment matters; source payload must preserve units and labels.
families.focus_keyboard: keyboard value selection and role assignment; feedback identifies missing values, wrong roles, units, or labels
families.target_proof_limit: eligible only for source-selection sub-proof unless paired with operation and answer tasks

families.student_action: Build a source to value to operation to answer chain.
families.bank_rules: Node bank includes source observation, role label, operation, answer, and conclusion nodes.
families.placement_or_order_rules: Order matters; all required chain roles must be present.
families.focus_keyboard: keyboard chain construction and reordering; feedback identifies missing source, operation, answer, or conclusion
families.target_proof_limit: eligible when reviewed target operation is chain construction or when paired with execution tasks

families.student_action: Place labels on graph, table, formula, or structure targets.
families.expected_shape: { kind: 'label_placement', placements: [{ labelId: string, targetId: string }] }
families.bank_rules: Label and target banks require visible names, accessible descriptions, and non-ambiguous distractors.
families.placement_or_order_rules: Placement target geometry or structure target ids must be stable across viewport and theme.
families.focus_keyboard: keyboard label pick/place/remove; feedback identifies misplaced labels and preserves visual context
families.target_proof_limit: eligible for representation proof only when placement is the reviewed target action
